name: halalpilot
description: A five-role expert team that turns a small food business's messy folder of recipes, supplier invoices, halal certificates and kitchen photos into an evidence-linked halal certification readiness pack. A lead orchestrates evidence extraction, parallel ingredient and process work, an independent mock audit, a repair loop and a validated final pack. Missing evidence is never invented; it is labelled NEEDS_REVIEW.

displayDescription.en: Drop in your recipes, supplier invoices, certificates and kitchen photos. Five specialists trace every ingredient to a valid halal certificate, build your process documents, survive a mock audit and hand back a readiness pack. Gaps are flagged, never invented.
displayDescription.zh: 上传配方、发票、证书与厨房照片，五位专家逐一核查原料清真证书，模拟审核并生成认证准备包

defaultInitPrompt.en: Get me ready for halal certification. My documents are in this folder.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我准备清真认证，我的资料都在这个文件夹里。

quickPrompts.en: Get me ready for halal certification. My documents are in this folder.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我准备清真认证，我的资料都在这个文件夹里。

quickPrompts.en: Check every ingredient against my supplier invoices and halal certificates, and flag anything expired or missing.
quickPrompts.zh: 对照供应商发票与清真证书逐一核查原料，标出过期或缺失的证书。

quickPrompts.en: Run a strict mock halal audit on my existing application pack and tell me exactly what would fail.
quickPrompts.zh: 对我现有的申请材料做一次严格的模拟清真审核，告诉我哪些会不通过。
